authority: owner directive, 2026-08-11. Prose form: docs/PD_PLANNING_OS.v001.md. This file is the machine form and is what scripts read.

brand.one_line: Prime Documentary shows you the hidden rules nobody tells you about.
brand.test: Every episode must end up at: this could happen to you.
brand.note: The audience subscribes to a VIEWPOINT, not a topic. That is what lets a viewer who came for a police story stay for a bank story, an HOA story, an insurance story, an algorithm story.

premise_score.supersedes: The 70-point gate in PD_EDITORIAL_STRATEGY.v001.md section 3. The owner raised the bar in the same week; 85 is binding. The earlier 8-axis rubric there is replaced by the 8 axes below.

axes.question: Does the viewer feel this could happen to them?
Is there a 'wait, that is allowed?' moment?
Is what is lost large -- money, freedom, home, job, family?
Does one sentence make a brutal title?
Protagonist -> incident -> it gets worse -> reversal or outcome?
Can it be nailed down with public records and court documents?

premise_score.hard_rule: An interesting subject is not enough. Only subjects a viewer would feel they LOST something by not watching.

series.name: LEGAL, BUT HOW?
series.thesis: Things that are lawful and still feel indefensible.

series.name: ONE TRAFFIC STOP
series.thesis: An ordinary day, a patrol car, one small decision, a changed life.

series.name: THEY TOOK THE MONEY
series.thesis: Losing money translates across every border.
series.thumbnail_rule: a huge figure plus the protagonist is sufficient

series.name: INNOCENT
series.thesis: Not true crime. What happens when the system is wrong.
series.note: Sell the failure of the institution, never the murder.

series.name: WHAT POLICE CAN ACTUALLY DO
series.thesis: Never a rights explainer. Always: here is what happened to one person.

series.name: THE FINE PRINT
series.thesis: Rules nobody reads that change a life. Not 'corporations are evil'.

series.name: YOUR DATA KNOWS
series.thesis: The category that will still be growing in ten years.

series.name: THE HOUSE WASN'T REALLY THEIRS
series.thesis: A home carries money, family, status and retirement at once.

series.name: THE SYSTEM SAID NO
series.thesis: An algorithm or an institution stops a life. Title it around the human.

series.name: ONE SMALL MISTAKE
series.thesis: Small cause, enormous consequence. Viewers watch to ask 'could I have avoided it?'

series.name: THE PRICE YOU NEVER SAW
series.thesis: Money, split out from S03 and pointed at pricing.

series.name: 48 HOURS THAT CHANGED EVERYTHING
series.thesis: Sell TIME, not the institution. Timestamped, cinematic.

title_archetypes.shape: He Said One Word. It Changed the Case.

title_rule: Twenty candidates per episode, generated against these eight shapes and no others. The title and the thumbnail must not say the same thing.

example.title: Police Took His $86,900. He Was Never Charged.
example.image: cash, a man, a patrol car

production_order: 1. find the thing a human finds abnormal -- not a theme
4. SCORE. Under 85 and the episode is not made. This gate comes BEFORE research.
5. primary sources, court records, public documents
7. the first thirty seconds are reviewed separately, on their own
order_note: The old order was theme -> script. That is abolished. Scoring happens before research, so a weak premise costs hours instead of days.
slate_note: Not a quota to complete. Capital allocation: when a pillar breaks out, double down on it mid-slate; when one dies, cut it. Supersedes the 35/30/25/10 split in PD_EDITORIAL_STRATEGY.v001.md section 2.

funnel.principle: Making AI generate videos matters less than making AI throw away the 99.5% of premises that are weak.

learning_engine_note: After a hundred episodes this yields win rates specific to PD's own audience -- e.g. female protagonist x explicit amount x Government x 'They Took' title x three-word thumbnail. Generative AI is available to everyone; this dataset is not.

integrity.absolute: Never bend a fact to fit a title. Outcomes differ by state and by case; a title written before the research is a hypothesis, not a promise.
integrity.ai_imagery: Where the subject is a real event, AI-generated people and scenes must never be presented as authentic record. Label reconstructions.
